notes.title: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos Release Coming November 4!
notes.content:
[h3]Release date confirmed: November 4, 2025 🎉[/h3][p][/p][p]Hi everyone!
We’ve got some exciting news: [i]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/i] will officially launch on [b]November 4, 2025[/b]. Mark your calendars, because chaos is coming![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QiVZsfM92do;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔨 What we’ve been working on[/h2][p]Over the past months, our small indie team has been polishing the game and making sure the cleaning chaos feels as fun (and unpredictable!) as possible. Here’s a peek:[/p][list][*][p][b]New tools[/b] – from vacuums to… “less conventional” devices 🤪[/p][/*][*][p][b]Physics tweaks[/b] – smoother chaos, funnier fails, better co-op experience[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cats[/b] – yes, even more cats, and they’re cheekier than ever 🐱[/p][/*][*][p][b]Levels[/b] – new environments to test your teamwork… or destroy it[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Why “Cleaning Chaos”?[/h2][p]We always wanted to make a co-op game that mixes [b]teamwork and trolling[/b]. You [i]can[/i] try to clean properly, but it’s just as much fun to knock over your friend’s bucket, ride a vacuum, or let a cat steal your tools. It’s that mix of order and disaster that makes every session unpredictable.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]👀 What’s next?[/h2][list][*][p][b]Playtests are open sign up now[/b]! Your feedback helps us a ton.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist on Steam to get notified on launch day:[/b]
 [/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117430/Purrrifiers_Cleaning_Chaos/"][/dynamiclink][/p][list][*][p]More sneak peeks coming in future devlogs – including behind-the-scenes looks at level design, cat AI, and chaos physics.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💬 Join the chaos[/h2][p]We’d love to hear from you![/p][list][*][p]Are you [b]Team Clean[/b] 🧽 or [b]Team Chaos[/b] 💥?[/p][/*][*][p]Which cat behavior would you love to see in the game?[/p][/*][/list][p]Drop a comment, share your ideas, and get ready for November 4![/p][p]Thanks for supporting us – you’re the reason we can keep making silly, chaotic games like this. ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]— The [i]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/i] dev team[/p]

notes.title: More cats incoming!
notes.content:
Hello Dear Purrrifiers!

With your feedback in mind, we are currently working on improving all the aspects of the game that aren’t as tidy as we would like them to be. For the moment being, our main focus is to optimize the game and make it run smoothly on most computers. At the same time we’re working on adding more features and content to the game!

However, there was one thing that struck us the most. Somehow, we included only Mr. Bubble! Can you imagine our reaction? It went more or less like this::
Hey, how many cats are in the demo?
One.
ONE?!?! HOW DID WE INCLUDE ONLY ONE CAT IN THE GAME?!?!
Weeeeell, we’re working on it.

Even though Mr. Bubble was purely majestic in his presence, he can’t be the only cat in the game. How can you become a true Purrrifier without a PURRRing companion next to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/1d86b66907d473998321cf13c6bb9ee6353de218.png[/img]

We have so many ideas on how to include more cats in the game. And we won’t limit ourselves to simple solutions like random cats wandering the streets for you to pet them. We’re going to include them, but there’s going to be so much more!

Here’s some of our ideas:

Bringer of Purrrs - this cat will be your faithful companion, whose job will be to bring you lost items and other things that you struggle finding (after appropriate payment in snacks)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/98a44b2aac872f6990f8cb65a546455c8c293374.png[/img]

DistCATtor - a companion specialised in creating CHAOS. Distracting dogs blocking your path, making some mess for NPC to go somewhere else. Without this help you won’t be able to reach some places.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/61ee4062637f663f065745fd6ec15acf86809307.png[/img]

CATambo - dual pressure washer specialist. This cat will help you and clean every stain with you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/fb6d8ab3692704acbbea2512eff2ebb731c466fe.png[/img]

And many. many more! Cats will be present in every part of the game, starting with plot, quests, side stories and ending with technical features. There will be enough PURRRing for everyone!

Of course, we won’t neglect all dog-lovers playing our game. There will be a few dogs you can pet as well, however Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos is focused around cats and they will play the main role in the game.

Stay tuned for more information about the game and we’ll make sure to bring you some great news! For now, that’s all from us.

Also, while you’re here, we wish you Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
May the PURRR be with you.
Devs

notes.title: We Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello Purrrifers!

[h3]Today [u]we[/u] want to [u]reveal[/u] a bit more about the game. Here we will share some key stuff you'll find in [b]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/a88b6e73c7094ff3715fb4d562b0f036e8a128c3.png[/img]

[u][h3][b]CORE OF THE GAME:[/b][/h3][/u]

[b]Single Player[/b] - Experience the game in a solo mode where you can tackle challenges on your own.

[b]Online Co-op[/b] - Team up with friends online to clean and solve puzzles together in cooperative multiplayer mode.

[b]Story[/b] - Immerse yourself in a story-driven experience filled with quirky characters and unexpected twists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/3fbafc234562bcc9ee531f775b468d98831fcfa0.gif[/img]

[b]Creative Freedom[/b] - lots, lots of ways to have fun (more about it in next devlog)

[b]Lots of references and jokes[/b] - Enjoy numerous pop culture references and humor scattered throughout the game.

[b]Open World[/b] - Explore a vast open world filled with interactive environments and diverse areas to clean and conquer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uiOMqYt.gif[/img]

[b]Replayability[/b] - Each mission can be completed in various ways, affecting dialogues and outcomes.

[b]Loads of events and quests[/b] - Encounter dynamic events like street protests, appliance malfunctions, and even dealing with personal emergencies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/41e9321315580d30d782be6d33c3c402e9b03218.gif[/img]

[b]Randomness[/b] - Discover random occurrences on the map that add surprise and variety to your gameplay.


[u][h3][b]MAIN FEATURES[/b][/h3][/u]

[b]Chemicals[/b]- Utilize different cleaning agents and chemicals to tackle various stains and dirt.

[b]Riddles[/b] - Solve engaging puzzles that require wit and strategy.

[b]Players Interactions[/b] -  Interact with other players in various ways, both cooperatively and competitively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/e94b917ef3b8cbdf36f7dab502968e52462f5727.gif[/img]

[b]Household appliances[/b] -  Operate a variety of cleaning appliances like washing machines, dishwashers, refrigerators, ovens, pressure washers, mops, and brooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/a58e23316b77a82f8a9c469b24505224dfb8f487.gif[/img]

[b]Player Base[/b] - Design and build your dream home, serving as your base of operations.

[b]Customization[/b] - Develop your profile by unlocking outfits, trinkets, pets, and more.


[u][h3][b]KEY MECHANICS[/b][/h3][/u]

[b]Dirt[/b] - Engage in the detailed process of cleaning dirt using various tools like pressure washers, sponges, and scrubbers (including ones with cute faces).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/c1ee13920db0973b6b33cc9d9611c5c10e0e9384.gif[/img]

[b]Cleaning process[/b] - Follow the entire cleaning processes step by step, such as gathering clothes, loading the washing machine, adding detergent, starting the cycle, hanging clothes to dry, and storing them in the closet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/5e844f825cf0c400ee14c62d1200a2e7b2bcaf22.gif[/img]

[b]Garbage[/b] - Collect and sort trash and other items, organizing them into the appropriate bins (dishes in the dishwasher, clothes in the washing machine).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ssobEM7.gif[/img]

[b]CATS[/b] - Experience interactions and gameplay elements involving cats that add to the chaos and fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/d59aa5d158d6e29ffb11afab68d7e30dbe7bd049.gif[/img]

[b]Vehicles[/b] - Drive and operate vehicles like lawnmowers, garbage trucks, and street sweepers as part of your cleaning duties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/ee9fc6366dd73dc7aaadbc71d79d102f2d261028.gif[/img]


[u][h3][b]OTHER FEATURES:[/b][/h3][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/42480a75c099e84485989ca27e21f38b395b6b46.png[/img]

[b]Eastereggs[/b] - Discover hidden secrets, Easter eggs, and collectibles by exploring every nook and cranny.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/82203b0dc5b8c49374adcab8733630bea93d23a8.gif[/img]

[b]Interactions [/b]-  Experiment with environmental interactions, such as spraying water on an outlet to cause a power outage that disables all electronics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/1e98b8d8b0b649aaa1f2c613efd0596064ded0e9.gif[/img]

[b]Theft[/b] - Engage in or prevent thefts within homes, adding a layer of challenge and strategy.

[b]Furniture[/b] - Arrange and customize furniture to your liking, enhancing your environment.

[b]NPC's[/b] - Engage in dialogues and accept quests from NPCs, enriching the game's narrative and world.

[b]Dying[/b] - Face the consequences of your actions, including potential dangers that can lead to your character's demise.

[b]Ragdoll[/b] - Enjoy the comical and unpredictable physics of ragdoll animations during gameplay.


From now on, we will be showing screenshots, gifs, videos and streams about what you can see above... and more! Stay tuned. 

Tell your friend to wishlist the game, as the more of us, the merrier!



Purrrifiers team

notes.title: We Work!

[h1]Welcome to our next devlog. We will tell you how we work on the Purrrifiers Cleaning Chaos game.
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/2fdf28848815f6ebfeadb5c21fbc62f1ba2f69ba.png[/img]

Currently, there are mainly two people working on the game and a few people for specific tasks. So, as you can see, we are a compact team. We plan to expand the team, but everything depends on the success of the game.

We chose the Unity engine to create the game. We have more experience in it, and therefore we can work more and faster. We are currently working on the first demo mission and building the entire game core. In the case of multiplayer and co-op games, many aspects of the game are more difficult than in the case of single-player games. We must constantly monitor the synchronization of objects in the world, take care of the quality of the connection, optimize everything by 4 times (since the game will be for 4 players).

As is often the case, many bugs appear during game production. Some of them might end up in the game, who knows? :)

notes.title: We Answer!
notes.content:
Welcome to our latest devlog! Today, we have a Q&A session to give you an inside look into the development of [b]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/b]. We answer your burning questions and take you inside our city of filth and chaos

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/747f038eb8187575c15a8b4de616444a4ea36b59.png[/img]

[b]Q: What kind of game Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos is?[/b]
A: It's a sandbox where players meet to take on the role of city cleaners, and cooperate to complete varied tasks sometimes challenging, other times freaky, funny, and unbelievable. 

[b]Q: What genre is this game?[/b]
A: Casual simulation mainly designed for teamplay with an open world requiring creativity and cooperation 

[b]Q: When will the game come out?[/b]
A: There is no specific date but our goal is to release the game within the 9-12 months.

[b]Q: What is the game engine?[/b]
A: Unity

[b]Q: Is there any demo?[/b]
A: We are currently working on a demo version, so stay tuned for more information.

[b]Q: Is there any in-game story?[/b]
A: Yes, but we don't want to reveal too much yet.

[b]Q: Is there an open world in the game?[/b]
A: Yes, we have a big town which is divided into districts. You can walk freely in a town and choose the district to start your challenge with friends or solo. We will share more about it in upcoming devlogs.

[b]Q: How will multiplayer work in the game?[/b]
A: Right now we are focusing on couch coop, but there will be online coop also. We create a server, choose a map, and wait for other players to join or add your friends. Right now we focus more on cooperation than rivalry (but we have that on our list also).

[b]Q: How many maps, tools, weapons, vehicles, and tasks will there be in the game?[/b]
A: We can't reveal that yet as we are non-stop creating more of that, but we will share more info about that in upcoming devlogs.

[b]Q: How much will the game cost?[/b]
A: We can’t reveal the full price yet but, we will adjust it to give the chance to have fun with Purrrifers for as many players as possible.

[b]Q: How creative can I be in the game?[/b]
A: It will depend on the task you'll need to do. Some are quite straightforward others can be done in many different ways.

[b]Q: Are you planning to make playtests?[/b]
A: Maybe, but it is too early to say anything more.

[b]Q: Are there going to be customization?[/b]
A: Yes, clothes, "weapon" skins, masks etc.

[b]Q: Are you planning the option of "skins" trading?[/b]
A: We are thinking about it. If players will want it, we will add it.

[b]Q: Where does the game take place?[/b]
A: Fictional filthy town, but we are considering adding real places in Early Access or future updates/dlcs

[b]Q: Will there be NPCs in the game?[/b]
A:  Yes, they will be scattered on the whole map. Some of them will help to progress our story, others will have special tasks for us.

[b]Q: What are your main inspirations?[/b]
A: Many things in the game will be quite original, but still we love games like Powerwash Simulator game, Who's Your Daddy, Goat Simulator and PayDay 1-2.

[b]Q: Are there day and night missions?[/b]
A: Right now we are working on day ones, but night missions are on our "to-do" list

[b]Q: How will the characters differ?[/b]
A: We are working on that, there will be considerable differences between them (stats, visuals, voices etc.)

[b]Q: What view will the game have?[/b]
A: First Person Perspective - FPP.

Q: How many people are working on the game?
A: We are a small indie studio, but we have a passionate and hard-working team. We have less than 5 people working on the title.

[b]Q: Will the game be released on phones or VR?[/b]
A: At the moment we are focusing on the PC version.

[b]Q: What are the hardware requirements?[/b]
A: You can find system requirements on our Steam:

[b]Q: What will distinguish the game from others?[/b]
A: Hilarious humor, memic situations, unique tasks, creative ways of achieving goals, funny references to other games and movies

[b]Q: What's with that 3 R in the name, PuRRRifiers?[/b]
Our team loves cats :) Simple as that we added them into our game. Not only their purring in the title but also as a special mechanic in the game.

[b]Q: What feature are you most excited about adding to the game?[/b]
A: Challenges and quests that require an open mind, creativity and a "casual" sense of humor.

If you couldn't find the answer to your questions, please come to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/HZcnCwtjmn][b]discord[/b][/url] and ask us, we are here for you!
